description.en: The display name of the ingest processor.
The offset value. The default value is 0.
The identifier of the ingest processor.
The number of entries to return. The default value is 200.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sls list-ingest-processors --project ali-test-project --processor-name parse-nginx-log --display-name Parse_Nginx_log --offset 0 --size 200 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sls GET /ingestprocessors --project ali-test-project --region cn-hangzhou --offset 0 --size 200 --displayName Parse_Nginx_log --processorName 'parse-nginx-log' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
